lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: In his dresser drawer, can you explain where that is?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Like the second one down, like in the middle row.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Go ba, I wanna back ya just a bit, you’re down at the car, and you’re hiding the car, right? (Brendan nods “yes”) Do you recall him taking the plates off?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: OK, what else did he do, he did somethin’ else, you need to tell us what he did, after that car is parked there. It’s extremely important. (pause) Before you guys leave that car.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: That he left the gun in the car.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: That’s not what I’m thinkin’ about. He did something to that car. He took the plates and he, I believe he did something else in that car. (pause).

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: OK. Did he, did he, did he go and look at the engine, did he raise the hood at all or anything like that? To do something to that car?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: It’s OK, what did he do?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: What did he do under the hood, if that’s what he did? (pause)

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: I don’t know what he did, but I know he went under.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: He did raise the hood? (Brendan nods “yes”) You remember that?
